hero-paragraph: Final-year Computer Engineering student at Universidade de Leiria e Oeste.
about-p1: I started programming in the 10th grade and never stopped. What began as curiosity — figuring out what happened on the other side of the screen — became how I solve problems.
about-p2: In secondary school I learned the fundamentals of several languages and interned at ITGlee. My degree took that further into databases, algorithms, software engineering and distributed applications, applied in team projects with real deadlines and code other people had to read.
projects-design-text: Two translation exercises: from Figma prototype to working interface. The focus here is visual fidelity and behaviour, not architecture.
modal-tooltip-note: Note: This project is hosted on a free server. If there have been no recent accesses, the server may take 1 to 2 minutes to start up on the first click. Thank you for your patience!
meta-description: Full-stack developer and final-year Computer Engineering student at Universidade de Leiria e Oeste. React, TypeScript, Laravel, Java, C++ and Docker. Nine projects, seven with a case study.
